schema.text: Why is it difficult to understand?
schema.help: Markings are lines and symbols painted on the ground. Signs are on poles or walls.

en.#Why is it difficult to understand?: Why is it difficult to understand?
en.#Markings are lines and symbols painted: Markings are lines and symbols painted on the ground. Signs are on poles or walls.
en.#The crossing or passage is hard to reco: The crossing or passage is hard to recognize
en.#It is not clear if people can walk here: It is not clear if people can walk here
en.#It is not clear if people can cycle her: It is not clear if people can cycle here

it.#Markings are lines and symbols painted: Le strisce e i segni a terra sono linee e simboli dipinti sul suolo. I segnali sono cartelli su pali o muri.
it.#Markings are missing: Mancano le strisce o i segni a terra
it.#Markings are faded: Le strisce o i segni a terra sono sbiaditi
it.#The crossing or passage is hard to reco: L'attraversamento o il passaggio è difficile da riconoscere
it.#It is not clear if people can walk here: Non è chiaro se qui si può passare a piedi
it.#It is not clear if people can cycle her: Non è chiaro se qui si può passare in bicicletta

fr.#Markings are lines and symbols painted: Le marquage désigne les lignes et symboles peints au sol. Les panneaux sont sur des poteaux ou des murs.
fr.#The crossing or passage is hard to reco: La traversée ou le passage est difficile à reconnaître
fr.#It is not clear if people can walk here: Il n’est pas clair que l’on puisse marcher ici
fr.#It is not clear if people can cycle her: Il n’est pas clair que l’on puisse circuler à vélo ici

de.#Why is it difficult to understand?: Warum ist es schwer zu verstehen?
de.#Markings are lines and symbols painted: Markierungen sind Linien und Symbole auf dem Boden. Schilder befinden sich an Masten oder Wänden.
de.#The crossing or passage is hard to reco: Der Übergang oder Durchgang ist schwer zu erkennen
de.#It is not clear if people can walk here: Es ist nicht klar, ob man hier zu Fuß gehen darf
de.#It is not clear if people can cycle her: Es ist nicht klar, ob man hier Rad fahren darf

tr.#Markings are lines and symbols painted: Yol çizgileri, yere boyanmış çizgi ve işaretlerdir. Tabelalar direklerde veya duvarlardadır.
tr.#The crossing or passage is hard to reco: Geçit veya geçiş noktası zor fark ediliyor
tr.#It is not clear if people can cycle her: Burada bisiklet sürülüp sürülemeyeceği açık değil

fa.#Markings are lines and symbols painted: خط‌کشی‌ها خطوط و نمادهایی هستند که روی زمین رنگ شده‌اند. تابلوها روی تیرها یا دیوارها نصب می‌شوند.
fa.#The crossing or passage is hard to reco: تشخیص گذرگاه یا معبر دشوار است
fa.#It is not clear if people can walk here: روشن نیست که آیا می‌توان اینجا پیاده رفت
fa.#It is not clear if people can cycle her: روشن نیست که آیا می‌توان اینجا دوچرخه‌سواری کرد

hu.#Markings are lines and symbols painted: A burkolatjelek a földre festett vonalak és jelek. A táblák oszlopokon vagy falakon vannak.
hu.#The crossing or passage is hard to reco: Az átkelőt vagy átjárót nehéz felismerni
hu.#It is not clear if people can walk here: Nem egyértelmű, hogy itt lehet-e gyalogolni
hu.#It is not clear if people can cycle her: Nem egyértelmű, hogy itt lehet-e kerékpározni

ar.#Markings are lines and symbols painted: العلامات الأرضية خطوط ورموز مرسومة على الأرض. أما اللافتات فتوضع على أعمدة أو جدران.
ar.#The crossing or passage is hard to reco: من الصعب التعرف على المعبر أو الممر
ar.#It is not clear if people can walk here: ليس واضحًا ما إذا كان يمكن للناس المشي هنا
ar.#It is not clear if people can cycle her: ليس واضحًا ما إذا كان يمكن للناس ركوب الدراجة هنا
